title: Llama 4 Scout and Maverick Release
summary: Meta announced Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick on April 5, 2025 and made both models available for download that day; Llama 4 Behemoth was described separately as still in training and not yet released.
significance: A dated public-release milestone for the first released models in Meta's Llama 4 family, while preserving the contemporaneous distinction between released Scout and Maverick models and the unreleased Behemoth model.

verification.note: Meta's first-party April 5, 2025 announcement explicitly introduces Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick and states that both were available for download that day. The same announcement explicitly says Llama 4 Behemoth was still training and was not being released, so Behemoth is not represented as a released technology in this candidate. No development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, people attribution, or relationship edges are inferred.
